description: Shared evaluation conformance vectors. Every SDK that evaluates flags locally must produce exactly these results. Generated expectations come from the Java reference implementation (backend), hand-written ones encode the spec.

evaluations.description: all clauses must match (fails on age)
null attribute is treated as missing
semver: an unparseable version is a non-match, so a negated clause matches (only missing attributes are exempt from negation)

clauses.description: IN string number is not numeric
MATCHES is a search, not a full match
numeric: hex is not a number
numeric: Infinity is not a number
numeric: boolean is not a number

murmur3.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
